turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
dard change-of-mind return.

Please provide a clear description of the damage, photos or a video of the item and its packaging, and record the damage precisely on the delivery note if possible. Report the issue within 72 hours of delivery.

A normal return follows the usual return windows: 100 nights for mattresses and other large items, 30 days for bed linen and mattress protectors, or 14 calendar days under the statutory withdrawal period. These windows do not replace the damage-claim process.

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail: You should not pay the change-of-mind return fees for a damaged item. Return transport is covered for a damage claim. The exact return arrangements depend on the country the item is being sent from. Which country would it be returned from?

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
A replacement timeline is set only after the damage has been assessed and the replacement approved. If a replacement is approved, the defective item is returned and the new item is delivered during the same appointment slot proposed by customer service.

Please send the photos or video and description of the damage through the contact form within 72 hours of delivery.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
If more than one item is damaged, please report every affected item. List each item separately and include clear photos or videos showing the damage and its packaging, with a short description of each issue.

Submit the claim within 72 hours of delivery through the contact form. Each affected item will be assessed before a replacement or refund is decided.

turns.q: Can I keep the damaged item or must I ship it back?
turns.replyTail:
Please keep the damaged item for now and do not send it back until your claim has been assessed.

If a replacement is approved, the defective item must be returned. Its collection and delivery of the new item take place during the same appointment slot proposed by customer service. If a refund is approved, the return arrangements depend on the outcome of the claim.

Please submit your photos or video and a description of the damage within 72 hours of delivery through the contact form.

turns.q: Will the replacement ship with priority?
What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
If the replacement also arrives damaged, please report the new damage as soon as possible. Send clear photos or a video of the replacement and its packaging, with a short description of the issue, through the same contact form. The claim must be submitted within 72 hours of that delivery.

The new damage will be assessed before the next solution is decided. Please keep the replacement and its packaging until you receive the return instructions.
